PR944's signed three-by-three obstruction needs one extra restoration pair, but its weighted example repeats B0. This **recursive-interface research construction** supplies a 14-query repair repeating each of the six possible operators. It proves the exact minimum `2 sum(c_F) + 2 min(c_F)` for arbitrary positive complete-query prices equal between signs, throughout the 288-member signed/permuted obstruction orbit.

The seed-58 fixture makes A1 cheapest. Full balanced lowering then costs **308 primitive calls versus 332** when keeping B0 as the repeated operator, with the same **four borrowed dirty arrays**. Every source, initial output value, connector and child scratch restores as required. The complete cost recurrence pays all children/inverses, coefficient/source access, frame and port admission, control, instruction emission/storage and head return. This is an exact query-alphabet optimum and operation-count comparison; no measured runtime or new kappa is claimed.

Reproduce with Python 3.10+ (standard library):

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/weighted-signed-connector-seed58/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/weighted-signed-connector-seed58/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_WEIGHTED_SIGNED_CONNECTOR witnesses=6 orbit=288 paths=61200 leaves=308_vs_332 dense=378 no_new_kappa`, then JSON with `PASS_WEIGHTED_SIGNED_PACKAGE`, `count: 47`, passing optimized relocation and deterministic regeneration. Add `--prices 16 28 40 52 4 10` to the first command to emit the exact A1-repeat word and minimum 308.

Verification covers all 720 support-bound source paths, 60,480 repeated-operator paths, six literal query and primitive words, 1,728 orbit query replays, full noncommutative dirty maps and inverses, 378 dense integer basis/dirty cases, six rational price orderings plus a tie, 18 tape trace/formula comparisons and 47 mathematical/package controls. The full suite passed on Git-index-exported submitted bytes. Selected-record integrity and all five selected-result tests also pass; staged whitespace is clean. Artifact writers explicitly preserve LF on Windows and Linux.

Only `research/weighted-signed-connector-seed58/` is added. Exact base: `abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf`; OS-random assignment seed **58**. The selected PR942/T37 conditional kappa `1661960547713947/10^18` and upstream files are unchanged. No full cold supplier replay, Linux CI success, human peer review or formal multiplication theorem is claimed. Physical supplier hosting, all-size/compiler, frame/owner admission, precision/tape and analytic transfer remain inherited or open. Sign-, state- or word-dependent prices are outside the optimum's stated model.

Ross Richardson's PR944 at `5dbcfbc63f646de5a1354f6b9760ec03837233f0` is the direct predecessor; its exact README/notice are retained with SHA256 and matching Git-blob provenance. PR889, PR934/943 and Chafik Boukhalfa's PR628 lineage keep credit. PR997 studies a different four-by-four Hadamard batch; PR1083 formalizes a five-source binary census. The refreshed 752-open-PR inventory contained no competing arbitrary-price signed-three-by-three repair. No predecessor executable code is imported.

Prepared for **@martinxxx9** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in reasoning, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0; inherited notices preserved. There is no pinned coordination issue, so the sprint claim and its final handoff are local. No other PR is merged, closed or edited.
